decisions.decision: Board agreed that if the sub-committee agenda situation arises again, the former Chairperson of the sub-committee meeting will set the agenda with the Administrative Assistant in time for posting.
decisions.quote: board members decided that if this situation should arise again, it would be the responsibility of the former chairperson to set the agenda, of the particular sub-committee which will be meeting

decisions.decision: Director directed to provide a COA Organizational Chart showing the COA's relationships with the Town, Supporters of the Eagle House and other entities, to be incorporated into the COA By-Laws.
decisions.quote: jane doyle requested that the director provide a coa organizational chart which outlines the relationship the coa has with the town

decisions.decision: Director will make a recommendation for the COA FY14 budget to be restored in full so the Senior Center can re-open on Fridays.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will make a recommendation for the coa fy14 budget to be restored in full so the senior center can re-open on fridays.

budget_items.topic: Kitchen equipment purchased through the Capital Plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: All new kitchen equipment bought through the Capital Plan, except the wall oven, has been received and installed; invoices are being paid through the Town Accountant.
budget_items.quote: all new kitchen equipment which was purchased through the capital plan, except the wall oven, has been received and installed.

budget_items.topic: Budget transfer for Direct Energy, Sewer and Water lines
budget_items.what_was_recorded: $1600 was moved out of the Direct Energy line into the Sewer and Water lines to cover bills, and another transfer into those lines is anticipated before the end of FY13.
budget_items.quote: $1600 needed to be transferred out of the direct energy line and put into the sewer ($1000) & water lines ($600) to cover bills.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Hotdogs and potato salad were bought to replace the MOC Nutrition meal that was not fit to eat on December 6.
budget_items.quote: hotdogs and potato salad were purchased to replace the meal.

budget_items.topic: Funding for new meal site menu
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director believes funding for the new menu can come from the COA Gift Fund at the Town Hall.
budget_items.quote: she believes that funding for this can be done through the coa gift fund at the town hall.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director is asking the Legislature to restore state funding per elder, which has been cut from $7 to $6.40.
budget_items.quote: restore funding to $7 per elder. approximately 25% of the population in massachusetts is over 60 and funding has been cut to $6.40 per elder.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said the state cuts were not as bad as expected and all departments should continue operations as is; no figures were given.
budget_items.quote: the town manager informed them that the town of lunenburg did not receive cuts from the state as bad as was previously thought and that all departments should continue operations as is.

budget_items.topic: FY14 budget and carryover of cuts
budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY14 budget packets have not arrived and are expected mid-January; the FY13 cuts will remain in FY14, and the Director will recommend restoring the COA budget in full.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has told all department heads that the fy13 cuts will remain in fy14.

budget_items.topic: Generator for Eagle House Senior Center
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director was to present a request to buy a generator for the Eagle House Senior Center at the Capital Plan meeting; no price was given and the Director does not expect approval.
budget_items.quote: discussing the request for the purchase of a generator for the eagle house senior center.

transfers.description: Transfer from the Direct Energy line to the Sewer line ($1000) and Water line ($600) to cover bills.
transfers.outcome: Reported as made; another transfer into the Sewer and Water lines is anticipated before end of FY13.
transfers.quote: $1600 needed to be transferred out of the direct energy line and put into the sewer ($1000) & water lines ($600) to cover bills.
